test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2017?
solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then the day on these dates will be:

21 May 2010 → Friday

21 May 2011 → Saturday

21 May 2012 → Monday

21 May 2013 → Tuesday

21 May 2014 → Wednesday

21 May 2015 → Thursday

21 May 2016 → Saturday

21 May 2017 → Sunday

Number of days between 21 May 2017 to 15 July 2017 = (10 + 30 + 15) = 55

55 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Sunday + 6 = Saturday

Therefore, it will be Saturday on 15 July 2017.

Hence, ‘**Saturday**’ is the correct answer.
